The Story

In the sunlit kingdom of Pixelhaven, the Princess lit the castle lanterns every evening, and the whole land slept in peace. Then a great storm carried her away to the old castle at the edge of the world. Only one hero, Prabhakaran, dared to follow.

💡

Hero Tips

  • 🍄 Grumpy mushrooms and sharp spikes crawl the forest road, so watch your step!
  • 🪙 Golden coins glitter along the path. Your coin count keeps growing from start to end!
  • 👊 Strike with J (or tap the fist), or stomp on a boss's head.
  • ⚔️ In chapter 2 you duel Lord Kraxis with a sword. Press J (or tap the attack button) to swing!
  • 🌑 Darker roads and angrier critters wait beyond the first castle.
